mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_asset (asset_id, document_id, asset_type, asset_key, page_number, locator, content_hash, parser_version, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid), CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid), #{assetType}, #{assetKey}, #{pageNumber}, COALESCE(CAST(#{locator} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), #{contentHash}, #{parserVersion}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_asset WHERE document_id = CAST(#{documentId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_asset_chunk (asset_id, chunk_id, asset_document_id, chunk_document_id) VALUES (CAST(#{assetId} AS uuid), CAST(#{chunkId} AS uuid), CAST(#{assetDocumentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{chunkDocumentId} AS uuid))
